Priority 1 (failing test root cause) per maintainer policy. Higher priorities checked: this IS the rank-1 finding, no higher-priority items exist. Not repeated low-value cleanup: last two epochs were Determinism (epoch 13, select-plus DAG) and Production Readiness (epoch 11, deprecation dedup) — neither was a hook/test timeout. deprecation-warning-noise-017 is disallowed as same failure class as epoch 11.
non_goals: do not refactor the entire hook system
do not change hook public API contract
implementation_steps: Reproduce the timeout: pnpm vitest run tests/playbook-hooks.test.ts
Inspect the test at line 225 — it calls reset() inside async it() and hangs
Trace reset() in the hook system to find why it never resolves
Apply minimal fix to make reset() resolve or the hook test complete
Verify the fixed test passes: pnpm vitest run tests/playbook-hooks.test.ts
Run full suite to confirm no regressions: pnpm vitest run tests/
selected.rollback_plan: git revert the single commit; the fix is scoped to hook error-handling behavior with an existing regression test
